counting_rule: Assign exactly one primary semantic cause per confirmed initial false alarm. If multiple defects exist, use the earliest violated applicability condition; closed-resource observation takes precedence over an also-missing table. Expected-side and observer-object edits have dedicated causes. Secondary defects are not double counted.

changed_state_or_phase_stale_observation.label_zh: 合法操作改变状态或观察阶段，但旧断言仍保留
changed_state_or_phase_stale_observation.definition: The operation sequence or observation boundary changes; the old predicate is applied to a different state or too early/late.

broken_setup_or_protocol_precondition.label_zh: 组合破坏必要前提、绑定或接口协议
broken_setup_or_protocol_precondition.definition: Before reaching the intended observation, the generated setup requires a missing resource/binding or violates a declared API/structural precondition.

expected_side_mistaken_for_input.label_zh: 误把 expected 一侧作为输入改写，破坏 oracle

wrong_observer_object.label_zh: actual 观察对象被替换成错误对象
wrong_observer_object.definition: The modified actual expression observes a helper/metadata object rather than the intended program result.
